judgmentCalls: 2610.23713v1 was placed only in Comparisons & systematics because its central contribution is a foreground-model systematic test of a proposed gamma-ray/LZ connection rather than a new proximate recoil mechanism.
The paper was marked diagnostic: it weakens a shared smooth-halo annihilation origin while explicitly retaining the possibility of a dark-matter contribution to the gamma-ray residual.
The addition received a semantic coordinate near other multi-messenger comparison papers and the next contiguous layout rank 133; all established coordinates and ranks remain unchanged.
